notes: Added missing schema/contract and rotation core logic stories to complete lifecycle coverage.

stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the persistent schema for bearer tokens including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, status (active/revoked), rotation_parent_id, and audit metadata. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB storage patterns and secure hashing of tokens.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-002

stories.title: Token Issuance and Rotation Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic for secure token issuance and rotation, including generation of cryptographically secure tokens, hashing before storage, linking rotated tokens via parent-child relationships, and enforcing single-active-token chains.

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement validation logic to enforce token expiration at request time, including configurable TTL, rejection of expired tokens, and audit logging for expiration-based denials.
